preconditions.description: The domain behavior is understood well enough to model events without a prototype.
A third-party API, crate integration, or performance boundary is uncertain and needs de-risking.

A promotion-style decision (hold or promote) is recorded in an epic's row or status line, and its feature-boundary consequence is recorded in plans/invariants.json. The gate is check-promotions: it validates each recorded decision against the shipped Cargo defaults, and it is decision-agnostic (it names no single feature), so it serves AGT and mcp-surface alike. Because it checks the whole catalog, a drift in any recorded decision fails the gate for every decision task, by design — it is a repository-wide coherence invariant, not a per-task probe.
